<!-- PT-BR: Gera um resumo curto para colar em um chat novo e continuar a tarefa sem perder contexto. -->
Write a summary for me to paste into a new chat, with:
- Objective and acceptance criteria of the task
- What is already done (changed files)
- What is left (next steps of the plan)
- Decisions made and why
- Open questions
Be short and objective.
